name: Unsanitized Query Formatting Vulnerability
description: SQL query built via format! without parameters, vulnerable to SQL injection
diff:
diff --git a/src/db.rs b/src/db.rs
--- a/src/db.rs
+++ b/src/db.rs
@@ -25,2 +25,4 @@
-    let query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1";
+    let query = format!("SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = '{}'", user_input);
+    sqlx::query(&query).fetch_all(pool).await
detective_response: - In `src/db.rs`: Query is constructed via `format!` string interpolation with `user_input` instead of parameter binding. This creates a severe SQL injection vulnerability.
